title: LM Studio — What it is
description: LM Studio (by Element Labs) is the friendly front door to local LLMs: search a catalog of GGUF models, download them in app, and chat in a clean UI — no terminal required. It can also serve any loaded model through an OpenAI-compatible local server (localhost:1234), so other apps and scripts can call the local model with the standard chat API. It made local AI feel like installing an app. It is made by Element Labs, Inc. and runs on Windows, macOS, Linux.
facts: Chat with documents (RAG) is built into recent versions.
Model presets tune GPU offload, context length and sampling per model.
The app shows download size and quantization before you commit.
